parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, typically rectangular and attached to the front of the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main access point to the cabinet interior, allowing users to open and close the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, enabling opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing support and shape to the entire furniture piece.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together, including the door, shelves, and base, ensuring stability and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom part of the cabinet made of solid wood, supporting the weight of the entire structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable foundation for the cabinet, distributing weight evenly and preventing tipping.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf inside the cabinet made of particle board, flat and rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf inside the cabinet made of particle board, providing additional storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet interior into sections for better organization of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf inside the cabinet made of particle board, located just above the base.
parts.Functional_description: It supports heavier items and contributes to the structural integrity of the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
